D_distribution.definition: D = V_a(N+) - V_a(N2+) at the model outlet, time-averaged <u> (official definition)

common_mode_invariance: Any species-independent potential offset c per unit charge (cathode-to-ground, plume potential beyond the 0.1 m outlet, the Eq. (11) V_p term) shifts V_a(N+) and V_a(N2+) by the same c, so D is invariant: it cannot change the ordering or D. Algebraic, collisionless.

literature_context_gurciullo2019.source: Gurciullo, Lucca Fabris & Cappelli, J. Phys. D 52, 464003 (2019), doi:10.1088/1361-6463/ab36c5, Sec. 4.3.3 (XeAir-3); author-hosted PDF sppl.stanford.edu; level 3, different thruster (Z-70), Wien filter 30 cm downstream
literature_context_gurciullo2019.velocity_definition: introduced in the source as 'The mean velocities of the ion species are ...'; the preceding sentence refers to the 'most probable ion velocity' of figures 23-24; ambiguous in the source (verify)

measured.evidence: level 3; measured by E x B probe 1 m downstream of the exit plane on centreline, bi-Gaussian peak fit, Eq. (11) plasma-potential correction; digitized from a raster figure
measured.source: Brabston et al., JPP 2025, doi:10.2514/1.B39623, Fig. 10 via the frozen measurement audit

observation_geometry.measured_reference_potential: Eq. (11): kinetic energy per charge at the probe minus the local plasma potential V_p at 1 m (Langmuir probe; values not published numerically, max uncertainty 0.25 V)
observation_geometry.model_outlet: right domain edge z = domain_m = 0.1 m from the anode (cases/p5_n2.json); value = ion.u[end] of the time-averaged frame (campaign/p5_n2_campaign.jl:70-76)
observation_geometry.model_reference_potential: phi = cathode_coupling_voltage = 0 V at the outlet (HallThruster.jl default, not set by bridge_lib.jl); anode side phi = V_d + anode sheath

official_reading_consistency.note: OUT_OF_DOMAIN is decided per key (chemistry validity) and is the same under readings A and B; the mixed-reading keys differ only between PASS and FAIL_VALIDATION.

role: NON-GATING physics forensics of the O5 E x B diagnostic; descriptive only. Never eliminates, admits, re-scores or re-labels. Official v1 outcome unchanged: all 9 screening candidates INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE, credible set empty.

time_average_definition_sensitivity.note: HallThruster.jl time_average() averages n, nu and u separately (postprocess.jl:77-79); the official O5 value uses <u>. <nu>/<n> is the density-weighted mean velocity. Neither is the most-probable velocity of the time-integrated distribution an E x B probe records. Sensitivity only; the official value stands.

velocity_space_m_over_Z_14_label.note: A Wien filter passes one velocity; species are assigned by assuming m/Z. N+ and N2^2+ (m/Z 14) are indistinguishable, and a species' V_a under a label is m_label u^2/(2 Z_label e). E14 = energy a model species would be assigned if its outlet velocity were read under the N+ label. Descriptive only; no re-attribution of the published peaks is proposed.
